text:
As Jd Com (JD) Stock Price Declined, Shareholder Iconiq Capital Decreased Its Stake; First Bancorp Pr (FBP) Shareholder Rock Point Advisors Has Lifted Stake 
April 17, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Rock Point Advisors Llc increased its stake in First Bancorp Pr (FBP) by 12.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rock Point Advisors Llc bought 136,545 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.95% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.26M shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.44M, up from 1.13M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rock Point Advisors Llc who had been investing in First Bancorp Pr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.45B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.15% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $6.71. About 720,362 shares traded. First BanCorp. (NYSE:FBP) has risen 8.46% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.09% the S&P500. 
Iconiq Capital Llc decreased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 6.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iconiq Capital Llc sold 18,649 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.51% with the market. The hedge fund held 261,812 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.85M, down from 280,461 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.27 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $0.13 during the last trading session, reaching $39.93. About 4.76 million shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has risen 29.73% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.18% the S&P500. 
Iconiq Capital Llc, which manages about $7.58 billion and $969.52M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 3,121 shares to 373,317 shares, valued at $65.88 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Gold Trust (IAU) by 27,758 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.68 million shares, and has risen its stake in Vanguard Index Fds (VTI). 
Analysts await JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) to report earnings on May, 14. They expect $0.01 earnings per share, down 87.50% or $0.07 from last year’s $0.08 per share. JD’s profit will be $14.34 million for 998.25 P/E if the $0.01 EPS becomes a reality. After $-0.10 actual earnings per share reported by JD.com, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -110.00% EPS growth. 
Among 22 analysts covering JD.com ( NASDAQ:JD ), 17 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 77% are positive. JD.com had 48 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Buy” on Monday, November 13. The rating was initiated by TH Capital with “Buy” on Tuesday, August 4. Nomura maintained the shares of JD in report on Thursday, August 11 with “Buy” rating. The rating was downgraded by Credit Suisse on Tuesday, May 10 to “Neutral”. The rating was initiated by Goldman Sachs with “Buy” on Friday, November 6. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has “Underperform” rating given on Wednesday, January 11 by Bernstein. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) earned “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Wednesday, August 31. JP Morgan maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Wednesday, November 15 report. The company was upgraded on Friday, January 22 by Nomura. HSBC initiated the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, November 10 report. 
Rock Point Advisors Llc, which manages about $351.72 million and $214.63 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Hortonworks Inc (NASDAQ:HDP) by 28,755 shares to 249,270 shares, valued at $5.01M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Computer (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,834 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 65,098 shares, and cut its stake in Domtar Corporation (NYSE:UFS).
